Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Class Blueprint

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.Blueprint
public final class Blueprint extends Object
Describes the columns and commands for one table, inside a Schema callback.

Column methods use Laravel's names and defaults. Each returns the new ColumnDefinition for chaining modifiers.

A blueprint belongs to the callback it is handed to: it is not thread-safe, and it can no longer be changed once the callback returns.

    • rawColumn

      public ColumnDefinition rawColumn(String column, String sql)
      Adds a column whose type and everything after it is SQL the caller writes, for what the builder cannot say.

      The SQL is written as given, like an Expression: build it from constants only, never from user input. It says the column's nullability and default itself; nullable() and defaultValue() add nothing, and only check() is written after it. On SQLite it cannot hold COLLATE, which a later table rebuild could not carry, and on an existing table it cannot hold a check or generated expression.

      Parameters:
      column - the column name, never null
      sql - the definition after the name, such as "integer not null default 0", never null or blank
      Returns:
      the column definition, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is invalid or sql is blank
      IllegalStateException - if the blueprint can no longer be changed
